scheme_name: Special Scholarship to Students Belonging to the Most Backward Castes among Scheduled Castes (Vandaniya Sant Shri Vasiyadada Scholarship)
other_conditions: Student must belong to one of the most backward castes among Scheduled Castes in Gujarat (Valmiki, Hadi, Nadia, Senva, Turi, Garo, Harijan‑Bava, Vanker‑Sadhu)
Student must be studying in Standard I to X
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹1000 per year for students in Standards I‑VIII and ₹1500 per year for students in Standards IX‑X.
